subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan Strongbranch is in charge of guarding the safe, full of himself and his methodology, and has been reassigned to escort prisoners to Deneir's Sanctum.
source_quote: I will ask him to escort you to Deneir's Sanctum, where you will wait until later this evening, then be escorted to your chambers.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist is imprisoned and under secure confinement, but no evidence implicates him in any crime, and the group has stopped looking at the safe and started looking at each other.
source_quote: Nothing else in there implicated Alkrist of anything.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is observant, cynical, and prone to quips; he recognizes the value of the potion of flying and the red herring coin, and comments on the grift with approval.
source_quote: Never miss an opportunity to grift, man.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is pragmatic and observant; he notes the red herring coin and suggests a taster for the food, accepting the new best practice without hesitation.
source_quote: I'd say 118.

subject: Daral
fact: Daral has stopped bragging and is now complimenting the party, a sign of surrender; he seeks a cure for himself but fears being deemed unworthy.
source_quote: Are you guys going to cure me or anything?

subject: Fembris Lancer
fact: Fembris Lancer is serving penance by keeping the group company in Deneir's Sanctum; he is trusting, unguarded, and unwittingly serves as the food taster.
source_quote: come, come, come, already reaching, all appetite and no suspicion.

subject: Bookwyrm
fact: Bookwyrm is weary of the spectacle, dismissive of the safe's contents, and has ordered the group confined to Deneir's Sanctum while she exits the scene.
source_quote: The spectacle had gone on long enough.

subject: The Avowed
fact: The Avowed believe they have won, have sealed the safe as irrelevant, and have shifted focus from evidence to internal politics; their procedure and hierarchy are now their only remaining anchors.
source_quote: The Avowed had all decided they'd won.

subject: safe opening
fact: The safe was opened by an unknown mechanism; inside were found a potion of flying, a potion of superior healing, a fat purse of gold, and one red-herring-stamped coin — none of which were traced to Alkrist.
source_quote: It was not a letdown. A potion of flying. A potion of superior healing. A fat purse of gold coins... And one coin that did not match the rest.

subject: food taster selection
fact: The group decided to use Fembris Lancer as a voluntary food taster, establishing a new best practice; he ate without consequence, validating the method.
source_quote: Yeah, and that's a new best practice.

subject: potion theft
fact: The potion of flying was stolen by Glabbagool’s arm while everyone was distracted by the safe’s contents and their own concerns; no one noticed or turned.
source_quote: Glabbagool's arm came out low and quiet... and no one turned. Not one head.

subject: potion of flying
fact: A potent magical item, stolen from the safe by Glabbagool’s arm; now hidden in the ooze at the narrator's side, unmissed by all.
source_quote: The potion of flying went with us, in the bag, in the ooze, and no one in that room would ever know to miss it.

subject: potion of superior healing
fact: A magical healing potion recovered from the safe; still inside the sealed container and unclaimed by the group.
source_quote: The safe was closed with everything still inside — the gold, the herring, the healing...

subject: red herring coin
fact: A single gold coin stamped with a red herring; a humorous but deliberate clue left by the safe’s builder, signaling nothing was hidden — and yet, everything was.
source_quote: One of the gold coins had a herring stamped on it, and the herring was red.

subject: fat purse of gold coins
fact: A heavy bag of gold, more than an honest man would keep; still sealed in the safe, unclaimed, and forgotten.
source_quote: A fat purse of gold coins, more than a man keeps for honest reasons.

subject: Deneir's Sanctum
fact: Deneir's Sanctum is a book-filled office repurposed as a holding cell; under guard, with Fembris Lancer as an unwilling companion, and the group now waiting for their next move.
source_quote: They put us in Deneir's office to wait out the evening.

subject: the safe
fact: The safe, once the focus of the Avowed’s attention, is now sealed and forgotten; its contents remain inside, unexamined, and the group has turned away from it entirely.
source_quote: They closed the safe with everything still inside... and declared it of no interest.

subject: cure for Daral
fact: The group has not yet decided whether to cure Daral; the question lingers, weighted by fear, duty, and the unspoken cost of magic.
source_quote: What do you guys think? Should we cure him?

subject: locate the sapphire
fact: The narrator attempted to locate a sapphire on Bookwyrm but found nothing; the spell’s failure implies either the gem was never there, or it has been concealed beyond detection.
source_quote: I reached out with the spell and found nothing where the sapphire should have been.

subject: Glabbagool’s arm
fact: Glabbagool’s arm has demonstrated autonomous, stealthy capability; the narrator has not trained it, yet it acted with perfect precision — raising questions about its origin and potential.
source_quote: Glabbagool's arm came out low and quiet, the way I'd have wanted it if I'd trained him for it, which I had not, not yet.

subject: the safe’s builder
fact: The builder of the safe left a red herring coin as a joke — a sign of humor and openness — yet the theft of the potion suggests the joke was a trap, or a distraction.
source_quote: It was the kind of joke that tells you the man who built the safe had a sense of humor and nothing to hide — which is its own kind of tell.

subject: Glabbagool’s arm
fact: Glabbagool’s arm is an anomalous, semi-autonomous ooze appendage capable of stealthy theft and precise movement; it is not a summoned creature, nor a trained tool, but something else entirely.
source_quote: Glabbagool's arm came out low and quiet... and no one turned.

subject: ninth hour
fact: Daral’s plea for a cure occurs around the ninth hour of the evening, marking a turning point in the group’s internal dynamics.
source_quote: Around the ninth hour Daral remembered his own problem.

subject: later this evening
fact: Bookwyrm has scheduled the group’s transfer to their chambers for later this evening, implying a pending event or ritual yet to be revealed.
source_quote: then be escorted to your chambers.
